observations: Industrial sewing machine on a white table.
The machine head has a red logo, but the text is illegible in the photo.
The machine is equipped with a foot pedal and a power cord.
The table surface shows some wear and scuffing.
A watermark 'Jiji' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The machine appears functional in the photo, but 'fairly used' is subjective and cannot be confirmed remotely.
The photo does not show a crack on the table surface.
The red logo is too blurry to read and confirm the origin.
No video or sound of the motor running is provided.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be weak, noisy, or burnt.
risks.proof: A video of the motor running at full speed.

risks.risk: The machine may be a generic brand rather than a Japanese model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand name and logo on the machine head.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Video of the motor running to check for noise or overheating.
Clear photo of the brand logo and any model number on the machine head.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
